name: RampantArsenalFork
title: Rampant Arsenal (Fork)
author: Dimm2101
description:
Fork of abandoned mod Rampant Arsenal. Ported to Factorio 2.0
Adds a variety of weapons to wage war. Adds Additional Turrets, Ammo Types, Landmines, Equipment, Capsules, Walls, Vehicles.
Optionally adds light versions of artillery shells compatible with snip-light-artillery mod.
Origninal mod is Rampant Arsenal https://mods.factorio.com/mod/RampantArsenal/
